hook: Humans cannot write a reward function for "good assistant response," but they can compare two responses and pick the better one. Fit a reward model to those comparisons, then RL the language model against it. Christiano 2017. InstructGPT 2022. The recipe that turned GPT-3 into ChatGPT. In 2026 it is mostly being replaced by DPO — but the mental model stays.
